note: The official current LDTE Programme page publishes a complete 72-unit Major Programme Requirement for S6 entrants: 9 Faculty Package units, 21 Foundation units, 35 Required units and 7 Elective units. Its Course List, explicitly applicable to students admitted in 2026-27 and thereafter, publishes 42 unique code-title-unit records after expanding CHEM1070/CHEM1072, PHYS1002/PHYS1004 and the cross-listed AIST3510/SEEM3510 into Programme-local records. The downloaded HTML was 109,737 bytes with SHA-256 2664cae9cc34f17e2029afeef994a778a83feea09c656ab15f394a1c13b16238. The seven Foundation courses and all fixed Required components close exactly to 21 and 35 units after selecting one Physics alternative. The Faculty Package closes to 9 units after selecting one Chemistry alternative. The Elective pool contains 1-, 2- and 3-unit courses and requires exactly 7 units; the local rule engine cannot prove every valid low-unit combination or prevent double-counting the AIST3510/SEEM3510 cross-list. Therefore all 42 official rows are exposed for browse-only planning with totalCreditRequired=0 and no graduation completion percentage. University Core requirements and open Free Electives are outside this Programme-specific course list and are not expanded.
